meta.title: Quick Commands
meta.description: Shows one-click command chips above the composer whenever the session is idle and has had at least one turn; a brand-new session shows none until its first turn settles. Clicking a chip sends that prompt to the agent; typing dismisses them. A leading suggestion is extracted from the agent's latest answer — questions, one-word replies it asks for, and waiting statements such as 'let me know once you're logged in'. Built-in and custom commands can both be deleted, with custom ones added, edited and reordered.
